description: Creates a new, empty project in the connected account, optionally with the client and the site address (looked up for sun and surroundings). Returns its id and the link where the floor plan can be uploaded. Costs no points.

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German) or "en" (English). Default "de".

title.description: Project name, e.g. "Haus Berger" or "Wohnanlage Lindenweg"

name: vedutum_create_project
